name: Image-to-Text Bilingual Dataset from Medical Prescriptions
description: A bilingual optical character recognition dataset consisting of 1,000 high-resolution images of handwritten medical prescriptions annotated in both Bengali and English. Each prescription is accompanied by transcription annotations for medication names, dosages, and instructions to support medical document understanding and OCR in healthcare informatics. Safeguard notice: Research dataset of de-identified prescriptions; not certified for autonomous pharmacy dispensing.
